records.text: Lantern Media is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Lantern Media
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Glad to have Lantern Media on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no first project, no invite, no milestone (stall_reasons). Only contact is Wrenfield's welcome note [email:8cfac998]; Rosa never replied and filed no tickets, so there's no observed engagement signal. 8 days remain, so self-serve activation is possible but unlikely absent any sign of intent.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first Lantern Media project up
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my welcome note last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is the step that makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to try it solo.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
